title: lde test coverage report
description: Per-file line coverage report written by `lde test --coverage --json <file>` (`--json` implies `--coverage`). When the command runs outside a package it aggregates one entry per package under `packages`.

totalExecutable.description: Total executable lines across all packages

totalCovered.description: Total covered lines across all packages

percent.description: Overall coverage percentage (totalCovered / totalExecutable * 100); 0 when nothing was executed

packages.description: One report per package that loaded in-scope source files

file.description: Path relative to the package dir, shown as src/... (modules load from the built target/<name> copy)

executable.description: Lines that can hold bytecode (non-blank, non-comment)

covered.description: Distinct executable lines executed by the test suite

percent.description: covered / executable * 100; 0 when the file has no executable lines
